tools.name: cancel_pending_order
tools.description: Cancel a pending order. If the order is already processed or delivered, it cannot be cancelled. The agent needs to explain the cancellation detail and ask for explicit user confirmation (yes/no) to proceed. If the user confirms, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled' and the payment will be refunded. The refund will be added to the user's gift card balance immediately if the payment was made using a gift card, otherwise the refund would take 5-7 business days to process. The function returns the order details after the cancellation.

params.name: order_id
params.doc: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.

params.name: reason
params.doc: The reason for cancellation, which should be either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'.

tools.name: exchange_delivered_order_items
tools.description: Exchange items in a delivered order to new items of the same product type. For a delivered order, return or exchange can be only done once by the agent. The agent needs to explain the exchange detail and ask for explicit user confirmation (yes/no) to proceed.

params.name: order_id
params.doc: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.

params.name: item_ids
params.doc: The item ids to be exchanged, each such as '1008292230'. There could be duplicate items in the list.

params.name: new_item_ids
params.doc: The item ids to be exchanged for, each such as '1008292230'.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.doc: The payment method id to pay or receive refund for the item price difference,

tools.name: find_user_id_by_email

tools.name: find_user_id_by_name_zip

params.name: last_name

params.name: zip

tools.name: can_send_mms
tools.description: Checks if the default messaging app can send MMS messages.

tools.name: check_apn_settings
tools.description: Checks the technical APN settings your phone uses to connect to your carrier's mobile data network. Shows current APN name and MMSC URL for picture messaging.

tools.name: check_app_permissions
tools.description: Checks what permissions a specific app currently has. Shows if the app has access to features like storage, camera, location, etc.

tools.name: check_app_status
tools.description: Checks detailed information about a specific app. Shows its permissions and background data usage settings.

tools.name: check_data_restriction_status
tools.description: Checks if your phone has any data-limiting features active. Shows if Data Saver mode is on.

tools.name: check_installed_apps

tools.name: check_network_mode_preference
tools.description: Shows the current network mode preference.

tools.name: check_network_status
tools.description: Checks your phone's connection status to cellular networks and Wi-Fi. Shows airplane mode status, signal strength, network type, whether mobile data is enabled, and whether data roaming is enabled.

tools.name: check_payment_request
tools.description: Checks if the agent has sent you a payment request.

tools.name: check_sim_status
tools.description: Checks if your SIM card is working correctly and displays its current status. Shows if the SIM is active, missing, or locked with a PIN or PUK code.

tools.name: check_status_bar
tools.description: Shows what icons are currently visible in your phone's status bar (the area at the top of the screen). Displays network signal strength, mobile data status (enabled, disabled, data saver), Wi-Fi status, and battery level.

tools.name: check_vpn_status
tools.description: Checks if you're using a VPN (Virtual Private Network) connection. Shows if a VPN is active, connected, and displays any available connection details.

tools.name: check_wifi_calling_status
tools.description: Checks if Wi-Fi Calling is enabled on your device. This feature allows you to make and receive calls over a Wi-Fi network instead of using the cellular network.

tools.name: check_wifi_status
tools.description: Checks your Wi-Fi connection status. Shows if Wi-Fi is turned on, which network you're connected to (if any), and the signal strength.

tools.name: connect_vpn
tools.description: Connects to your VPN (Virtual Private Network).

params.name: customer_id

params.name: line_id

tools.name: make_payment
tools.description: Makes a payment for the bill that the agent has sent you.

tools.name: reboot_device
tools.description: Restarts your phone completely. This can help resolve many temporary software glitches by refreshing all running services and connections.

tools.name: refuel_data
tools.description: Refuels data for a specific line, adding to the customer's bill. Checks: Line status must be Active, Customer owns the line. Logic: Adds data to the line and charges customer based on the plan's refueling rate.

params.name: customer_id
params.doc: ID of the customer who owns the line.

params.name: line_id
params.doc: ID of the line to refuel data for.

params.name: gb_amount

tools.name: reseat_sim_card
tools.description: Simulates removing and reinserting your SIM card. This can help resolve recognition issues.

tools.name: reset_apn_settings
tools.description: Resets your APN settings to the default settings.

tools.name: resume_line
tools.description: Resumes a suspended line. Checks: Line status must be Suspended or Pending Activation. Logic: Sets line status to Active, clears suspension_start_date.

params.name: customer_id
params.doc: ID of the customer who owns the line.

params.name: line_id
params.doc: ID of the line to resume.

tools.name: run_speed_test
tools.description: Measures your current internet connection speed (download speed). Provides information about connection quality and what activities it can support.

tools.name: send_payment_request
tools.description: Sends a payment request to the customer for a specific bill. Checks: - Customer exists - Bill exists and belongs to the customer - No other bills are already awaiting payment for this customer Logic: Sets bill status to AWAITING_PAYMENT and notifies customer. Warning: This method does not check if the bill is already PAID. Always check the bill status before calling this method.

params.name: customer_id
params.doc: ID of the customer who owns the bill.

params.name: bill_id
params.doc: ID of the bill to send payment request for.

tools.name: set_apn_settings
tools.description: Sets the APN settings for the phone.

tools.name: set_network_mode_preference
tools.description: Changes the type of cellular network your phone prefers to connect to (e.g., 5G, LTE/4G, 3G). Higher-speed networks (LTE/5G) provide faster data but may use more battery.

tools.name: suspend_line
tools.description: Suspends a specific line (max 6 months). Checks: Line status must be Active. Logic: Sets line status to Suspended, records suspension_start_date.

params.name: customer_id
params.doc: ID of the customer who owns the line.

params.name: line_id
params.doc: ID of the line to suspend.

params.name: reason
params.doc: Reason for suspension.

tools.name: toggle_airplane_mode
tools.description: Toggles Airplane Mode ON or OFF. When ON, it disconnects all wireless communications including cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth. Returns the new state of airplane_mode.

tools.name: toggle_data
tools.description: Toggles your phone's mobile data connection ON or OFF. Controls whether your phone can use cellular data for internet access when Wi-Fi is unavailable. Returns the new data connection status.

tools.name: toggle_data_saver_mode
tools.description: Toggles Data Saver mode ON or OFF. When ON, it reduces data usage, which may affect data speed. Returns the new data saver mode status.

tools.name: toggle_roaming
tools.description: Toggles Data Roaming ON or OFF. When ON, your phone can use data networks in areas outside your carrier's coverage. Returns the new data roaming status.

tools.name: toggle_wifi
tools.description: Toggles your phone's Wi-Fi radio ON or OFF. Controls whether your phone can discover and connect to wireless networks for internet access. Returns the new Wi-Fi status.

tools.name: toggle_wifi_calling
tools.description: Toggles Wi-Fi Calling ON or OFF. This feature allows you to make and receive calls over Wi-Fi instead of the cellular network, which can help in areas with weak cellular signal. Returns the new Wi-Fi Calling status.
